commands.name: sync

options.name: --include-table
options.description: Include only the specified table key (repeatable).

options.name: --parallelism
options.description: Max number of tables to export concurrently (overrides YAML parallelism when set).

options.name: --seed
options.description: Force a full snapshot export for change-tracking  jobs.

arguments.name: config
arguments.description: Path to the export configuration YAML file.

arguments.name: state
arguments.description: Path to the sync state YAML file.

commands.description: Export SQL Server change-tracking (or full-sync) deltas to CSV files.
